errors.text_span: Тази фигура илюстрира сравнение на масивните активации и феномените на attention sink в различни конфигурации на gating.
errors.evidence: This sentence describes the context of a larger, multi-panel figure from the paper, not the specific plot shown. The plot only shows the 'baseline' case, not a comparison of different 'gating configurations'.
The description fails to state the specific purpose of the chart, which is to show the 'first token attention scores of baseline', as indicated by the title.
The description completely omits any information about the x-axis, which is labeled 'layer' and has a range from 0 to approximately 23.

errors.text_span: Етикетите на осите са равномерно разположени на интервали от 0,1.
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The y-axis ticks are at intervals of 0.2, and the x-axis ticks are at intervals of 5.

errors.text_span: Линията започва на стойност 0
errors.evidence: The blue line does not start at 0. It starts at a value of approximately 0.05.

errors.text_span: достига максимум около 0,84 при стойност на оста X около 19
errors.evidence: The maximum value is reached at an X-axis value (layer) of 21, not 19.

errors.text_span: След това спада до 0,12 и се стабилизира на около 0,12.
errors.evidence: This is a complete misrepresentation of the line's behavior after the peak. The line drops from its peak of ~0.85 (at layer 21) to ~0.7 (at layer 22) and then to ~0.68 (at layer 23). It never drops to 0.12.

errors.text_span: Осите показват стойността на първия токен внимание, представена чрез линейна скала.
errors.evidence: This is ambiguous as it implies both axes show the 'first token attention score', when only the y-axis does. The x-axis represents the 'layer'.
The description fails to specify that the chart is about the "first token" attention score, a key detail present in the title, y-axis label, and legend.

errors.text_span: 从0到20
errors.evidence: The x-axis data goes up to layer 23, not 20.

errors.text_span: 刻度间隔为1
errors.evidence: The tick interval on the x-axis is 5, not 1.

errors.text_span: 刻度间隔为0.05
errors.evidence: The tick interval on the y-axis is 0.2, not 0.05.

errors.text_span: 代表了第一注意力分数的注意力分数
errors.evidence: The phrase is redundant and awkwardly constructed. It should simply be 'represents the first token attention score'.

errors.text_span: 然后在大约2层处达到最大值约为0.9
errors.evidence: This is a complete misreading of the graph. At layer 2, the score is very low (below 0.1). The actual maximum value of approximately 0.85 is reached at layer 21.

errors.text_span: 之后逐渐下降，在x轴的15层处达到约0.4
errors.evidence: The description of the trend is incorrect. The line does not gradually decrease after layer 2; it sharply increases after layer 5. Furthermore, the value at layer 15 is approximately 0.62, not 0.4.

errors.text_span: 然后开始上升并在x轴的结束处达到约为0.3
errors.evidence: The trend description is incorrect. The line fluctuates and then drops sharply at the end, it does not rise. The final value is approximately 0.4, not 0.3.
The description completely fails to mention the most salient feature of the line plot: the sharp, sudden increase in the attention score that occurs after layer 5.

errors.text_span: ranges from 0 to 20
errors.evidence: The x-axis tick labels go up to 20, but the data clearly extends beyond that to at least layer 22.

errors.text_span: incrementing by one
errors.evidence: The tick labels on the x-axis are at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20, indicating an increment of 5, not one.

errors.text_span: tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.1
errors.evidence: The tick labels on the y-axis are at 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 1.0, indicating an interval of 0.2, not 0.1.

errors.text_span: rising to a peak of approximately 0.92 at layer 18
errors.evidence: The peak of the blue line occurs at layer 21 with a value of approximately 0.85, not at layer 18 with a value of 0.92.

errors.text_span: decline back to around 0.15 at layer 20
errors.evidence: At layer 20, the value is approximately 0.78, not 0.15. The line does not decline to this value anywhere in the depicted range.

errors.text_span: teal line
errors.evidence: The dashed horizontal line is green, as shown in the plot and indicated in the legend, not teal.

errors.text_span: von 0 bis 20
errors.evidence: The x-axis represents layers and extends beyond 20, up to approximately layer 23. Limiting it to 20 is incorrect.

errors.text_span: mit Intervallen von Einheiten
errors.evidence: The major tick marks on the x-axis are shown at intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20), not intervals of single units.

errors.text_span: in Schritten von 0,1 angegeben sind
errors.evidence: The major tick marks on the y-axis are at 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 1.0, which corresponds to intervals of 0.2, not 0.1.

errors.text_span: einen Wert von 0,0 aufweisen
errors.evidence: The blue line starts at a value of approximately 0.05 at layer 0, it is visibly above 0.0.

errors.text_span: und bei Schicht 20 einen Wert von 0,85 erreichen
errors.evidence: At layer 20, the blue line has a value of approximately 0.78, not 0.85. The peak value of ~0.85 is reached at layer 21.

errors.text_span: steigt dann bis zu einem lokalen Maximum von 0,91 bei Schicht 13 an
errors.evidence: At layer 13, the value is approximately 0.59, not 0.91. The value 0.91 is not reached anywhere in the plot.

errors.text_span: bevor sie bis Schicht 18 einen Rückgang auf 0,62 aufweist
errors.evidence: At layer 18, the value of the blue line is approximately 0.75, not 0.62.

errors.text_span: und bei Schicht 20 schließlich auf 0,85 sinkt
errors.evidence: This description is incorrect in two ways: the value at layer 20 is not 0.85, and the line does not sink to this point from the previous one (it rises slightly from layer 19 to 20).

errors.text_span: Der y-Achse entspricht die Token-Aufmerksamkeitswerte
errors.evidence: The sentence has a grammatical error (incorrect dative case). It should be 'Der y-Achse entsprechen die Token-Aufmerksamkeitswerte' or rephrased for better clarity, e.g., 'Die y-Achse stellt die Token-Aufmerksamkeitswerte dar'.
